scientific_integrity: Analytic ODE and source-jump proof with independent renewal-age numerical consistency checks; numerical grids are not used as proof of infinite claims. Publication-priority risk persists.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary, symmetric resetting, one-dimensional OU only. For arbitrary symmetric gapped reset distributions the theorem classifies only the source-free central gap; complete global classification requires the equal-weight two-atom law. No transient, asymmetric, non-Poisson, or nonlinear-trap claim. Priority is not independently established.
title: Separation-independent modal transition for harmonically confined diffusion under symmetric resetting
